title: About Us
metaDescription: Small things, big smiles — get to know eiei, your friendly sticker and lifestyle brand.

intro.heading: Small Things, Big Smiles.
intro.body:
At eiei, we believe even the smallest details can make someone’s day a little brighter.

Founded by a small independent team, eiei started with a simple idea: to offer thoughtfully designed stickers and decorative items, while sharing creative ideas and useful tips with people who love adding a personal touch to their everyday life.

More than just a shop, eiei is a little space where creativity, inspiration, and self-expression come together.

whoWeAre.heading: Who We Are
whoWeAre.body:
eiei is a lifestyle brand under Picel Collections — the creative home behind a growing family of brands built around accessible, thoughtfully made products.

Picel Collections is the parent brand, and eiei is our little corner for lifestyle goods: decorative stickers, planner accessories, stationery, and other small things that bring more personality to your everyday essentials.

We’re just getting started, but our goal stays simple: to keep making products that spark creativity and make everyday moments a little more fun.

whoWeCreateFor.heading: Who We Create For
whoWeCreateFor.body:
Our community is made up of students, university students, and young creators who love expressing themselves through small creative details.

Whether you’re decorating your notebooks, assignments, laptop, water bottle, bag, journal, or your little corner of the world — we hope our products become part of your daily inspiration.

moreThanProducts.heading: More Than Products
moreThanProducts.body:
We believe creativity is better when it’s shared.

Alongside our products, we publish articles, tips, and ideas about stickers, stationery, decoration, and everyday inspiration. We want this to be a place where you can discover something new, learn something useful, and enjoy being creative — your own way.

Our mission isn’t just to make things you’ll love. It’s to build a little community where creativity feels simple, accessible, and fun for everyone.

ourStory.heading: Our Story
ourStory.body:
eiei is still a young brand, and this is only the beginning.

Every product, article, and little idea we share reflects our love for thoughtful design, quality, and keeping things affordable. As we grow, we want to keep creating things that bring a smile to your day.

Thank you for being part of our story from the very start.

getInTouch.heading: Get in Touch
getInTouch.channels: We’d love to hear from you. Say hi through any of these:

thankYou: Thank you for visiting eiei. We can’t wait to create something special with you.
